datasets.name: Roboflow Bed Exit v4
datasets.labels: bed_exit, hospital_bed, in_bed bounding boxes; 848 images
datasets.use: Static ROI debugging; original class boxes are not generic COCO person labels

datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 shown on dataset card

datasets.name: FallVision
datasets.modality: Original RGB MP4, processed MP4, pose CSV
datasets.use: Select original bed RGB MP4; annotate Bed/Safe ROI and event times
datasets.access: Public Dataverse v2 export confirms 60 unrestricted RAR archives; preview selects the smallest Bed/Fall and Bed/No Fall raw archives plus matching pose CSV archives (705,092,125 bytes total)
datasets.license: Dataverse v2 metadata declares CC0 1.0; the associated article is CC BY-NC 4.0

datasets.name: SLP2022
datasets.modality: Static RGB, LWIR, depth, pressure; uncover/cover1/cover2
datasets.labels: 14-joint LSP pose labels; no bed-exit events
datasets.access: SLP2022 has 130,749 encrypted files and only empty directories are plain. The older MICCAI19 ZIP exposes exactly 45 password-free 896x1600 RGB frames for simLab subject 00004 under cover2; its joints_gt_RGB.mat remains encrypted. Use these 45 frames only for unlabeled qualitative testing
datasets.download_function: download_slp_miccai19_public_rgb; download_slp_samples only after approved password
datasets.license: Non-commercial research/teaching; dataset terms differ from code license

datasets.name: BlanketSet
datasets.use: Normal blanket movement/occlusion false alarms after access is granted
datasets.access: Official CKAN package_show API returned 200; notes explicitly say video access is currently restricted due to legal considerations
datasets.license: Catalog metadata says CC BY-SA; this does not override restricted video access

datasets.name: In-Bed Patient Segmentation

datasets.name: eNightTrack

datasets.download_function: Provider-approved files only; download the open-access paper as provenance
datasets.license: Confirm dataset permission with the authors

datasets.name: HP-BED / BED Net
datasets.labels: Pose sequence and bed-exit action labels described by the paper
datasets.access: The paper is public; no official public HP-BED-Dataset archive was verified
datasets.download_function: Download the open paper; provider-approved dataset files only
datasets.license: Dataset terms are not published on the article landing page

datasets.name: BlanketGen2-Fit3D
datasets.modality: 1,217,312 transparent RGBA synthetic blanket layers for Fit3D; original RGB is separate
datasets.labels: No labels in the Zenodo release; frame correspondence allows separately licensed Fit3D pose/SMPL labels to be reused
datasets.use: Occluded-pose training candidate, followed by evaluation on real bed images
datasets.access: Official Zenodo record 23260194 verified. Supplement is 38,151,323 bytes and videos.zip is 29,768,449,960 bytes; eight Blender archives require substantially more storage
datasets.license: Blanket layers CC BY 4.0; original Fit3D is a separate non-commercial research license

datasets.name: Patient Care Activity Recognition

datasets.labels: Clip-level action class including lying, sitting up, and standing up from bed
datasets.use: Viewable bed-action clips and action-recognition reference; add ROI event timestamps manually
datasets.access: Public Hugging Face repository, approximately 6.45 GB
datasets.license: Synthetic subset CC BY 4.0; real clips retain each source dataset's terms
